name: reference_10k_33pf
description: User-specified fixture: two nominal 10 kohm precision resistors, two nominal 33 pF capacitors, and 60 unpopulated cells.
notes: Nominal values are not traceable measurements. Tolerance and allowed device error are unknown until supplied.
CAP reports total LC capacitance. Compare each capacitor only after subtracting that same cell's unloaded baseline under matching wiring and measurement conditions.
Floating cells are expected OPEN (X0D) only in RES, with fresh acquired data. They are not zero pF or zero V.
No automatic coefficient fitting, NVS write, or extrapolation from four reference cells to all 64 cells.
